name: Parallel-SSHI-FullBridge
rationale: The reference FBR fails S2 and S4 due to the low open-circuit voltage (Voc ~1.9V in S4) and diode drops. A Parallel SSHI (Synchronous Switch Harvesting on Inductor) is used to flip the voltage on Cp at the peaks, increasing the effective voltage seen by the rectifier and improving energy extraction. A full-bridge rectifier with low-drop Schottky diodes (DSCH) is used for maximum recovery. A Zener diode (DZ33) clamps the output to 3.3V to prevent exceeding the absolute maximum in S3. A large output capacitor (4.7uF) filters the ripple.
